old: In total, 1510 metabolites were detected. As shown in Fig. 5, the two CCD1 lines and the wild type separated along PC1, which explained 91.1% of the variance. β-Ionone in the two CCD1 lines was only 1.34- and 1.04-fold relative to the wild type, neither reaching the two-fold threshold, which is consistent with volatilization loss; however, the non-volatile C18 apocarotenoid cleavage products rose consistently by 2.1- to 4.5-fold in both lines, against a background of overall downregulation of terpenoids in the same batch. This counter-trend accumulation indicates that the introduced CCD1 was catalytically active. Further comparison between the cytosolic line and the chloroplast-targeted line showed that the transit peptide fusion did not increase product accumulation, while the upstream precursor mevalonic acid in the chloroplast-targeted line was 2.02-fold that of the cytosolic line, indicating that the limiting factor lies in the enzyme itself rather than in substrate supply.
